verdict.rationale: Munito AI is API-first: inference, tool calls, vision, speech to text and document extraction are exposed through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs, and a public OpenAPI spec is served. However, the console handles key and usage management, and nothing shows those functions are available through the API, so full UI parity is unproven. missing for 10: API endpoints for key management and usage/billing (console functions), an explicit parity statement between console and API, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Munito AI supports the OpenAI Chat Completions, Responses and speech to text APIs, plus the Anthropic Messages API.
The console manages your keys and usage.
The full Markdown document includes the guides and public API contract.
